description: For every unary partial recursive function \(f\), there is a natural-number index \(e\) for which \(\varphi_e=f\), including equality of their domains.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.phi_complete {f : ℕ → Part ℕ} (hf : Nat.Partrec f) :
  ∃ e, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.phi e = f
